• Low dead space: Reduces medication waste

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: Control Company Logger-Trac Temp Mini Datalogger
PRODUCT_NAME: Control Company Logger-Trac Temp Mini Datalogger
DESCRIPTION:
Active LCD display technology allows the duration (cumulative time) for the temperature excursion to be viewed on the display immediately without the need to download data. The user may select the acceptable temperature parameters (high and low temperature values) in 1° increments. The cumulative alarm duration timer is started each time the reading is outside of the acceptable temperature parameters to provide a total excursion time since the start of recording.

LCD display shows the running alarm tally based on the acceptable temperature range and recording interval. Alarm tally is incremented when the reading goes outside the acceptable temperature parameters during the recording interval and continues to be incremented if the temperature has remained outside the acceptable temperature parameters during the following interval.

For complete flexibility, the user-defined recording interval may be set based on the number of desired days to log (from 4 hours to 365 days) or the desired time interval (from every 2 seconds to every 24 hours). Internal flash memory stores 7680 readings. To insure that no data is lost, once the memory is full the thermometer will stop logging data (data will not be overwritten).

Measuring only 2 x 1 x 0.5 inches and weighing only 0.75 ounces, it is the perfect solution for monitoring material in transit as well as reagents, clinical samples, vaccines, pharmaceuticals and food items in any location. Waterproof design (IP66) eliminates concerns when located in damp environments or areas that are required to be washed down.

Individual Logger-Trac™ Thermometers are pre-programmed with alarm values of 2°C (low) and 8°C (high) and a recording interval to allow for 30 days of recording (readings are logged every 5 minutes, 33 seconds).

Required Accessories (To download data and restart datalogger):
• MaxiThermal Software (Cat. No. 350-98557)
• Cradle and USB cable for Logger-Trac™ Temp Mini Datalogger (Cat. No. 3850-98524)

DESCRIPTION: These blue, disposable SMS coveralls are made of a durable, three-layer fabric that protects against light liquid splashes and sprays, while also keeping you cool for extended periods. The durable, three-layer SMS fabric (Spunbond Meltblown Spunbond) protects against light liquid splashes and sprays and provides a superior particulate barrier. A storm flap over the zipper adds an extra layer of protection, preventing liquids and other contaminants from entering through exposed zipper seams. An attached hood helps protect the neck and shoulders, while secure elastic wrists and ankles offer a secure closure that keeps contaminants out.

DESCRIPTION:
Coated Steel Belt Driven Blowers have been specifically designed to meet the demanding day-to-day ventilation requirements for a wide range of hood choices. Durable and easy to maintain, Coated Steel Blowers are the recommended accessory for fume hoods used for low to moderately corrosive applications. • Flow-through vent holes and louvers allow for air circulation that cools the motor
• Phenolic coating on impeller and housing is corrosion resistant
• Powder-coated base and weather cover provide long life in extreme weather
• Belt-driven with adjustable sheave saves energy and allows you to fine tune air volumes
• Removable weather cover allows easy access for lubrication and sheave alignment
• Self-adjusting gravity belt tightener ensures consistent performance
• Motor mount keeps the motor in place should the belt ever fail
• Forward curved impellers are balanced to ensure quiet operation and optimum air delivery
• Factory lubricated pillow block bearings reduce maintenance and increase life
• Blowers have low RPM for quiet operation
• Sound levels generally range between 64 and 88 decibels depending on blower size
• Variable exhaust orientation adjusts to eight outlet positions for installation flexibility
• Adjustable discharge direction accommodates auxiliary-air requirements or unusual blower locations
• Ductwork required (not included)

PRODUCT_NAME: Explosion Proof Coated Steel Blower, 10 in. inlet, 1/3 HP
DESCRIPTION:
Coated Steel Belt Driven Blowers have been specifically designed to meet the demanding day-to-day ventilation requirements for a wide range of hood choices. Durable and easy to maintain, Coated Steel Blowers are the recommended accessory for fume hoods used for low to moderately corrosive applications. They are offered in a broad spectrum of capacities from 175 to 1960 CFM at static pressures to 1.50 in. H2O. Explosion-proof models have non-sparking aluminum impellers and UL-listed explosion-proof motors for maximum safety.

Both types of Coated Steel Blowers feature:
• Flow-through vent holes and louvers allow for air circulation that cools the motor
• Phenolic coating on impeller and housing is corrosion resistant
• Powder-coated base and weather cover provide long life in extreme weather
• Belt-driven with adjustable sheave saves energy and allows you to fine tune air volumes
• Removable weather cover allows easy access for lubrication and sheave alignment
• Self-adjusting gravity belt tightener ensures consistent performance
• Motor mount keeps the motor in place should the belt ever fail
• Forward curved impellers are balanced to ensure quiet operation and optimum air delivery
• Factory lubricated pillow block bearings reduce maintenance and increase life
• Blowers have low RPM for quiet operation
• Sound levels generally range between 64 and 88 decibels depending on blower size
• Variable exhaust orientation adjusts to eight outlet positions for installation flexibility
• Adjustable discharge direction accommodates auxiliary-air requirements or unusual blower locations
• Ductwork required (not included)
Image(s) are representative of the product group and not necessarily the individual product.

PRODUCT_NAME: Coated Steel Blower, 10 in. inlet, 1/3 HP
DESCRIPTION:
Coated Steel Belt Driven Blowers have been specifically designed to meet the demanding day-to-day ventilation requirements for a wide range of hood choices. Durable and easy to maintain, Coated Steel Blowers are the recommended accessory for fume hoods used for low to moderately corrosive applications. They are offered in a broad spectrum of capacities from 175 to 1960 CFM at static pressures to 1.50 in. H2O. Explosion-proof models have non-sparking aluminum impellers and UL-listed explosion-proof motors for maximum safety.

Both types of Coated Steel Blowers feature:
• Flow-through vent holes and louvers allow for air circulation that cools the motor
• Phenolic coating on impeller and housing is corrosion resistant
• Powder-coated base and weather cover provide long life in extreme weather
• Belt-driven with adjustable sheave saves energy and allows you to fine tune air volumes
• Removable weather cover allows easy access for lubrication and sheave alignment
• Self-adjusting gravity belt tightener ensures consistent performance
• Motor mount keeps the motor in place should the belt ever fail
• Forward curved impellers are balanced to ensure quiet operation and optimum air delivery
• Factory lubricated pillow block bearings reduce maintenance and increase life
• Blowers have low RPM for quiet operation
• Sound levels generally range between 64 and 88 decibels depending on blower size
• Variable exhaust orientation adjusts to eight outlet positions for installation flexibility
• Adjustable discharge direction accommodates auxiliary-air requirements or unusual blower locations
• Ductwork required (not included)

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: NPT non-metallic vent, stainless steel flame arrester
PRODUCT_NAME: NPT non-metallic vent, stainless steel flame arrester
DESCRIPTION:
Provide emergency pressure venting in the event of a fire to avoid drum failure and catastrophic consequences. All safety drum vents automatically relieve pressure between 3 and 8 psi (30 to 55kPa) and include a flame arrester to absorb and safely dissipate heat. Valve within the vent is tested to allow 61 cubic inch (1-L) of water through a 3/8-in (9.5-mm) pipe nipple in less than 6 seconds for vacuum relief during drum dispensing operations. Vacuum relief permits smooth liquid flow and prevents possible drum collapse and leakage. Vacuum relief is automatic on vertically-installed vents and manual on horizontally-installed vents.

Safety fill vents and funnels fit the 2-in (51-mm) bung on a vertically-stored drum. The brass vent provides automatic pressure and vacuum relief, and includes a brass cap with safety chain tethered to the vent to prevent misplacement or loss. Remove cap during drum filling operations. Model no. 08211 includes a 9-in(229-mm) wide polyethylene funnel to facilitate solvent waste disposal and reduce spillage. Keep vent capped in closed position after filling operations to prevent flammable vapor from escaping. Six-inch (152-mm) flame arrester safely dissipates heat and prevents flashback from external ignition sources.

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: Control Company Logger-Trac RH/Temperature Data Logger
PRODUCT_NAME: Control Company Logger-Trac RH/Temperature Data Logger
DESCRIPTION:
Active LCD display technology allows the duration (cumulative time) for the temperature excursion to be viewed on the display immediately without the need to download data. The user may select the acceptable humidity and temperature parameters (high and low values) in 1% or 1° increments. The cumulative alarm duration timer is started each time the humidity and/or temperature reading is outside an acceptable parameters providing a total excursion time since the start of recording.

LCD shows the running alarm tally based on the acceptable humidity/temperature range and recording interval. Alarm tally is incremented, when readings move outside parameters during the recording interval.

For complete flexibility, the user-defined recording interval may be set based on the number of desired days to log (from 4 hours to 365 days) or the desired time interval (from every 2 seconds to every 24 hours). Internal flash memory stores 7680 readings. To insure that no data is lost, once the memory is full the thermometer/hygrometer will stop logging data (data will not be overwritten).

Measuring only 3.25 x 2 x 1.12 inches and weighing only 0.85 ounces, it is the perfect solution for monitoring material in transit as well as reagents, clinical samples, botanical environments, pharmaceuticals and food items in any location. Waterproof design (IP66) eliminates concerns when located in damp environments or areas that are required to be washed down.

Multi-point calibration on an individually-numbered Traceable® Certificate which assures accuracy from an ISO/IEC 17025:2005 (1750.01) calibration laboratory accredited by A2LA. Individual Logger-Trac™ RH/Thermometers are pre-programmed with alarm values of 2°C (low) and 8°C (high) and a recording interval to allow for 30 days of recording (readings are logged every 5 minutes, 33 seconds).

Accessories required for user-set parameters:
• MaxiThermal Software (Cat. No. 350-98557)
• USB cable for Logger-Trac™ LN2 and RH/Temperature (Cat. No. 350-98560)

PRODUCT_NAME: Control Company Temperature/Humidity Bluetooth Data Logger compatible with GO App and LIVE Cloud Service; Ambient Sensor
DESCRIPTION:
Bluetooth device is the ideal transit partner for monitoring materials between destinations. Safely transport reagents, clinical samples, vaccines, pharmaceuticals and food items to any location. With the TraceableGO mobile app, view if an alarm was triggered, generate an instant data report. Device stores up to 90 alarm events, records readings once every 5 minutes by default, or the user may adjust the reading interval between one minute to once every 12 hours, logging duration is 227 days (7.5 months). TraceableGO™ Bluetooth devices are pre-programmed with alarm values. Broad compatibility easy Bluetooth connection works with any Bluetooth-enabled devices. Once TraceableGO™ arrives, enable the Bluetooth transfer to a smartphone, open the TraceableGO™ app (available on iTunes or Google Play) pair the device to smartphone download the recorded data since the device was enabled and send a report directly from a mobile device. Supplied with battery and Traceable® Certificate.

• Press START to begin trip monitoring
• Place device inside a small cooler or even an entire pallet of material
• Once the trip has ended, double-press START/STOP to enable Bluetooth and export the data using the TraceableGO™ mobile app
• TraceableGO mobile app immediately identifies if the contents experienced conditions outside user-defined parameters

Traceable® Certificate:
Multi-point calibration on an individually-numbered Traceable® Certificate which assures accuracy from an ISO/IEC 17025:2005 (1750.01) calibration laboratory accredited by A2LA. It indicates traceability of measurements to the SI units through NIST or other recognized national measurement institutes (NMI) that are signatories to the CIPM Mutual Recognition Agreement.

Specifications:
• Relative humidity range: 0 to 95% RH (non-condensing)
• Relative humidity resolution: 0.1%
• Relative humidity accuracy: 3% RH between 5 to 75%, otherwise +/-5% RH
• Temperature range: -20 to 70°C (-4 to 158deg;F)
• Temperature resolution: 0.1
• Temperature accuracy: +/-0.4°C between -10 and 70°C, otherwise +/-0.5°C
• Storage capacity: 90 alarm events; 65,536 temperature readings
• Weight: 0.65 ounces
• Dimensions: 3.5 x 2 x 0.79 in.

• Powder-coated base and weather cover provide long life in extreme weather
• Belt-driven with adjustable sheave saves energy and allows you to fine tune air volumes
• Removable weather cover allows easy access for lubrication and sheave alignment
• Self-adjusting gravity belt tightener ensures consistent performance
• Motor mount keeps the motor in place should the belt ever fail
• Forward curved impellers are balanced to ensure quiet operation and optimum air delivery
• Factory lubricated pillow block bearings reduce maintenance and increase life
• Blowers have low RPM for quiet operation
• Sound levels generally range between 64 and 88 decibels depending on blower size
• Variable exhaust orientation adjusts to eight outlet positions for installation flexibility
• Adjustable discharge direction accommodates auxiliary-air requirements or unusual blower locations
• Ductwork required (not included)

PRODUCT_NAME: Explosion Proof Coated Steel Blower, 10 in. inlet, 1/6 HP
DESCRIPTION:
Coated Steel Belt Driven Blowers have been specifically designed to meet the demanding day-to-day ventilation requirements for a wide range of hood choices. Durable and easy to maintain, Coated Steel Blowers are the recommended accessory for fume hoods used for low to moderately corrosive applications. They are offered in a broad spectrum of capacities from 175 to 1960 CFM at static pressures to 1.50 in. H2O. Explosion-proof models have non-sparking aluminum impellers and UL-listed explosion-proof motors for maximum safety.

Both types of Coated Steel Blowers feature:
• Flow-through vent holes and louvers allow for air circulation that cools the motor
• Phenolic coating on impeller and housing is corrosion resistant
• Powder-coated base and weather cover provide long life in extreme weather
• Belt-driven with adjustable sheave saves energy and allows you to fine tune air volumes
• Removable weather cover allows easy access for lubrication and sheave alignment
• Self-adjusting gravity belt tightener ensures consistent performance
• Motor mount keeps the motor in place should the belt ever fail
• Forward curved impellers are balanced to ensure quiet operation and optimum air delivery
• Factory lubricated pillow block bearings reduce maintenance and increase life
• Blowers have low RPM for quiet operation
• Sound levels generally range between 64 and 88 decibels depending on blower size
• Variable exhaust orientation adjusts to eight outlet positions for installation flexibility
• Adjustable discharge direction accommodates auxiliary-air requirements or unusual blower locations
• Ductwork required (not included)

DESCRIPTION: These blue, disposable SMS coveralls are made of a durable, three-layer fabric that protects against light liquid splashes and sprays, while also keeping you cool for extended periods. The durable, three-layer SMS fabric (Spunbond Meltblown Spunbond) protects against light liquid splashes and sprays and provides a superior particulate barrier. The outermost layer of spunbond polypropylene provides strength, while the middle layer of meltblown polypropylene provides liquid resistance via a microporous film. A storm flap over the zipper adds an extra layer of protection, preventing liquids and other contaminants from entering through exposed zipper seams. An attached hood helps protect the neck and shoulders, while secure elastic wrists and ankles offer a secure closure that keeps contaminants out.

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: NPT non-metallic vent, plated steel flame arrester
PRODUCT_NAME: NPT non-metallic vent, plated steel flame arrester
DESCRIPTION:
Provide emergency pressure venting in the event of a fire to avoid drum failure and catastrophic consequences. All safety drum vents automatically relieve pressure between 3 and 8 psi (30 to 55kPa) and include a flame arrester to absorb and safely dissipate heat. Valve within the vent is tested to allow 61 cubic inch (1-L) of water through a 3/8-in (9.5-mm) pipe nipple in less than 6 seconds for vacuum relief during drum dispensing operations. Vacuum relief permits smooth liquid flow and prevents possible drum collapse and leakage. Vacuum relief is automatic on vertically-installed vents and manual on horizontally-installed vents.

Safety fill vents and funnels fit the 2-in (51-mm) bung on a vertically-stored drum. The brass vent provides automatic pressure and vacuum relief, and includes a brass cap with safety chain tethered to the vent to prevent misplacement or loss. Remove cap during drum filling operations. Model no. 08211 includes a 9-in(229-mm) wide polyethylene funnel to facilitate solvent waste disposal and reduce spillage. Keep vent capped in closed position after filling operations to prevent flammable vapor from escaping. Six-inch (152-mm) flame arrester safely dissipates heat and prevents flashback from external ignition sources.

DESCRIPTION:
Coated Steel Belt Driven Blowers have been specifically designed to meet the demanding day-to-day ventilation requirements for a wide range of hood choices. Durable and easy to maintain, Coated Steel Blowers are the recommended accessory for fume hoods used for low to moderately corrosive applications. • Phenolic coating on impeller and housing is corrosion resistant
• Powder-coated base and weather cover provide long life in extreme weather
• Belt-driven with adjustable sheave saves energy and allows you to fine tune air volumes
• Removable weather cover allows easy access for lubrication and sheave alignment
• Self-adjusting gravity belt tightener ensures consistent performance
• Motor mount keeps the motor in place should the belt ever fail
• Forward curved impellers are balanced to ensure quiet operation and optimum air delivery
• Factory lubricated pillow block bearings reduce maintenance and increase life
• Blowers have low RPM for quiet operation
• Sound levels generally range between 64 and 88 decibels depending on blower size
• Variable exhaust orientation adjusts to eight outlet positions for installation flexibility
• Adjustable discharge direction accommodates auxiliary-air requirements or unusual blower locations
• Ductwork required (not included)

PRODUCT_NAME: Explosion Proof Coated Steel Blower, 10 in. inlet, 1/4 HP
DESCRIPTION:
Coated Steel Belt Driven Blowers have been specifically designed to meet the demanding day-to-day ventilation requirements for a wide range of hood choices. Durable and easy to maintain, Coated Steel Blowers are the recommended accessory for fume hoods used for low to moderately corrosive applications. They are offered in a broad spectrum of capacities from 175 to 1960 CFM at static pressures to 1.50 in. H2O. Explosion-proof models have non-sparking aluminum impellers and UL-listed explosion-proof motors for maximum safety.

Both types of Coated Steel Blowers feature:
• Flow-through vent holes and louvers allow for air circulation that cools the motor
• Phenolic coating on impeller and housing is corrosion resistant
• Powder-coated base and weather cover provide long life in extreme weather
• Belt-driven with adjustable sheave saves energy and allows you to fine tune air volumes
• Removable weather cover allows easy access for lubrication and sheave alignment
• Self-adjusting gravity belt tightener ensures consistent performance
• Motor mount keeps the motor in place should the belt ever fail
• Forward curved impellers are balanced to ensure quiet operation and optimum air delivery
• Factory lubricated pillow block bearings reduce maintenance and increase life
• Blowers have low RPM for quiet operation
• Sound levels generally range between 64 and 88 decibels depending on blower size
• Variable exhaust orientation adjusts to eight outlet positions for installation flexibility
• Adjustable discharge direction accommodates auxiliary-air requirements or unusual blower locations
• Ductwork required (not included)

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: Coated Steel Blower, 12 in. inlet, 1/2 HP
PRODUCT_NAME: Coated Steel Blower, 12 in. inlet, 1/2 HP
DESCRIPTION:
Coated Steel Belt Driven Blowers have been specifically designed to meet the demanding day-to-day ventilation requirements for a wide range of hood choices. Durable and easy to maintain, Coated Steel Blowers are the recommended accessory for fume hoods used for low to moderately corrosive applications. They are offered in a broad spectrum of capacities from 175 to 1960 CFM at static pressures to 1.50 in. H2O. Explosion-proof models have non-sparking aluminum impellers and UL-listed explosion-proof motors for maximum safety.

Both types of Coated Steel Blowers feature:
• Flow-through vent holes and louvers allow for air circulation that cools the motor
• Phenolic coating on impeller and housing is corrosion resistant
• Powder-coated base and weather cover provide long life in extreme weather
• Belt-driven with adjustable sheave saves energy and allows you to fine tune air volumes
• Removable weather cover allows easy access for lubrication and sheave alignment
• Self-adjusting gravity belt tightener ensures consistent performance
• Motor mount keeps the motor in place should the belt ever fail
• Forward curved impellers are balanced to ensure quiet operation and optimum air delivery
• Factory lubricated pillow block bearings reduce maintenance and increase life
• Blowers have low RPM for quiet operation
• Sound levels generally range between 64 and 88 decibels depending on blower size
• Variable exhaust orientation adjusts to eight outlet positions for installation flexibility
• Adjustable discharge direction accommodates auxiliary-air requirements or unusual blower locations
• Ductwork required (not included)
Image(s) are representative of the product group and not necessarily the individual product.

Coated Steel Belt Driven Blowers have been specifically designed to meet the demanding day-to-day ventilation requirements for a wide range of hood choices. Durable and easy to maintain, Coated Steel Blowers are the recommended accessory for fume hoods used for low to moderately corrosive applications. They are offered in a broad spectrum of capacities from 175 to 1960 CFM at static pressures to 1.50 in. H2O. Explosion-proof models have non-sparking aluminum impellers and UL-listed explosion-proof motors for maximum safety.

Both types of Coated Steel Blowers feature:
• Flow-through vent holes and louvers allow for air circulation that cools the motor
• Phenolic coating on impeller and housing is corrosion resistant
• Powder-coated base and weather cover provide long life in extreme weather
• Belt-driven with adjustable sheave saves energy and allows you to fine tune air volumes
• Removable weather cover allows easy access for lubrication and sheave alignment
• Self-adjusting gravity belt tightener ensures consistent performance
• Motor mount keeps the motor in place should the belt ever fail
• Forward curved impellers are balanced to ensure quiet operation and optimum air delivery
• Factory lubricated pillow block bearings reduce maintenance and increase life
• Blowers have low RPM for quiet operation
• Sound levels generally range between 64 and 88 decibels depending on blower size
• Variable exhaust orientation adjusts to eight outlet positions for installation flexibility
• Adjustable discharge direction accommodates auxiliary-air requirements or unusual blower locations
• Ductwork required (not included)
